verdict.rationale: An AI assistant inside client-facing platforms such as Catalyze, GDHQ or the Contract Generator is a fair question for a law firm that ships client tools, so the axis applies. However, the only AI assistant in the evidence is ChatGD, an internal chat app for the firm's own attorneys. No evidence shows clients or users can delegate tasks to a built-in assistant inside any Gunderson product, so ChatGD is an adjacent internal tool rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
